subject.title: fix(reply): strip leaked current-message scaffolding and (no output) placeholders

question: Should this PR be merged after clean or triaged checks with the new shared `empty-tool-output` and scaffold-stripping semantics, or should maintainers require different delivery semantics or live Telegram proof first?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes shared reply delivery normalization and channel skip classification, which is a maintainer-owned message-delivery contract rather than a purely local code cleanup.

options.title: Merge after clean checks
options.body: Accept the shared sanitizer/normalizer contract, rerun or triage the two broad CI failures, and merge this PR as the fix for the linked issue.

options.title: Request live Telegram proof

options.title: Pause for alternate semantics
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want `(no output)` treated as a silent channel skip or want the scaffold stripping owned elsewhere.
